items.detail: Viking Construction & Supplies: of 7 CPES evaluation(s) of its other DPWH contracts in the last 3 years, 2 were over the termination threshold, 2 (29%) were behind schedule. Worst, on 2023-09-14: 15% or more negative slippage during construction (CPES scored schedule 0.00 of 0.15; at 15% the procuring entity is required to start termination or take over the work); workmanship scored 0.257 of 0.40 (contract not stated).

items.detail: Viking Construction & Supplies has 3 on-going DPWH road(s) possibly stalled and 0 far behind schedule (weekly stage-3 list; DPWH progress data can lag).

assessment.derivation: 1 strong + 0 weak signal(s) → Medium priority (1 strong, or 2 weak) → Yellow.

steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Open the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Implementation delays and performance anomalies
sub: Compare DPWH's reported progress with citizen reports, Bisto.ph inspections and satellite images.

If CPES is cited: open the DPWH quarterly CPES report for that date and confirm the contract, the slippage and the scores. A CPES rating is the agency's own evaluation; ask the district office for the evaluation sheet and the catch-up programme.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check the site before work starts: satellite imagery of the stretch, earlier contracts on the same road, and whether a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, a TPM civil-society partner) can take geotagged photos later.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
